description: This file defines the class WordWithCount, which models a word and its associated frequency and variants, providing methods for managing and comparing word counts within a text processing context.

classes.name: WordWithCount
classes.description: A class representing a word with its frequency and variants, supporting comparison based on frequency.

methods.name: WordWithCount
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a word, setting frequency to zero.

methods.name: WordWithCount
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a word and a specified frequency.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the lowercase key of the word.

methods.name: getWord
methods.description: Returns the most frequently used variant of the word.

methods.name: getFreq
methods.description: Returns the current frequency of the word.

methods.name: addFreq
methods.description: Increments the frequency count and updates variants with a new word.

methods.name: addOtherWord
methods.description: Merges another WordWithCount object into this one, updating frequency and variants.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this WordWithCount to another based on frequency for sorting.
